en: When the bordermoon collapses, the nearby miasma is purified.
What on Earth is this..? It's horribly creepy.
Eh? Eh?
What's happening?
I-it broke?!
But, I never even touched it, right? Right?
Erm, well...
I had nooooothing to do with it!
....Alice.
Eh?!
Alice!
That voice. Father?!
Alice, Alice!
Father, that's you is it not?!
Oh, Alice. Has my voice reached you?
Yes, Father! It really is him!
Alice, listen closely to what I'm about to say. There's something you need to know.
Say, Father, where are you now?! How are you doing?
Pipe down and listen! I don't have much time!
O-okay, Father.
That thing you just destroyed is known as a bordermoon.
Bordermoon?
It creates a miasma that makes the labyrinth a hospitable environment for the monsters. If you can destroy it, that should make the monsters vulnerable enough for you to defeat.
Oh goodness! I could never do that.
Yes, you can. Don't worry, since you... after all.
Huh? What? Father, I couldn't hear you clearly!
Father?! Hey, Father! Say something! Hey!
Father.. Father!
Fatheeeeer!
Father, I'm going to do this. Hang in there.

note: sfx: When the bordermoon collapses, the nearby miasma is purified.
